d7Note: D7 eligibility implemented in assemble_universe.py. Policy exclusion beyond the sim's equip rules -- weapon type(s) 6: Druids can equip polearms, but TBC never itemised one for them: of the 49 items carrying feral attack power, 39 are staves and 10 are maces, and no polearm carries any. In cat form the weapon is a pure stat stick -- its damage is discarded -- so a polearm with no feral attack power is not a low-ranked candidate, it is a non-candidate, and nine of the 39 druid-equippable polearms have an entirely empty stat line. They are excluded from the pool because their presence in a feral weapon list reads as a tool bug rather than as a correct last place.
